statistics_unit: Balanced biographies stratified by profession and gender
information_budget: All target-only executors use the same target dictionaries. Label-free maps use 3000 natural biographies of other professions. purpose: Confirmation on the balanced test split with the initialization chosen on the dev split, three training seeds and the SHIFT use stage.
